sentences.en: Only I was able to jump across the stream then.
sentences.zh: 只有我能当时跳过那条溪流。

sentences.en: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
sentences.zh: 在这样湍急的溪流里游泳一定很危险。

sentences.en: An office machine is cranking out a stream of documents.
sentences.zh: 一台办公机器正在批量生成文件。

senses.zh: 溪流；流动；潮流；光线；（数据）流
